parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description: Filters the results by cluster type.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: Filters the results by labels. Specify labels as key=value pairs, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout mode. Valid values: Tree and List.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values are desc and asc.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. The minimum value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The minimum value is 1.

parameters.name: ParentQuotaId
parameters.description:
Filters the results by parent quota ID:

- If this parameter is not specified, all quotas within the tenant are returned, including both root and child quotas.

- If this parameter is set to an empty string, all root quotas are returned.

- If a specific parent quota ID is provided, all child quotas of that parent are returned.

parameters.name: QuotaIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of up to 100 quota IDs to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported.

parameters.name: QuotaName
parameters.description: Filters the results by quota name. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Valid values are Lingjun, ECS, and ACS. The default value is ECS.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- QuotaName

- Status

- CPU

- Memory

- GPU

- GmtCreatedTime

- GmtModifiedTime

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of quota statuses to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return detailed information. Valid values:

- true: Returns detailed information.

- false: Does not return detailed information.

parameters.name: WorkspaceIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of up to 10 workspace IDs to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported.

parameters.name: WorkspaceName
parameters.description: The name of the associated workspace.
